To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
a novel method of Distributed Hierarchical Clusters for Web Mining is developed and implemented.
we propose a novel method of hierarchical clustering for Web data.
a distributed hierarchical clustering system for Web mining is developed and implemented, which is based on the Self-Generated Neural Network (SGNN) algorithm.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the problem of clustering web documents and generating hierarchical conceptual structure for the web.
developing an effective method for distributed hierarchical clustering of web documents, and building a web mining system based on the method.
the problem of how to automatically generate a hierarchical clustering of web documents based on the content of the web documents.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the proposed clustering method has the following advantages: 1) it is a fully automatic hierarchical clustering method; 2) the method can be implemented in a distributed fashion; 3) the method is independent of order of the web documents presented; 4) the method produces a natural cluster hierarchy; 5) the method is scalable to large data; 6) the method can include multimedia data into the clustering process; 7) the method can generate a visualization of the clustering results;
the clustering method is a very effective tool for web mining.
the method proposed in the paper is very effective for clustering web documents, and the system built based on the method is very useful for web mining and information retrieval.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

we have successfully developed a new method for distributed hierarchical clustering, which is based on our previous work of Self-Organizing Neural Networks (SONN) and Self-Generated Neural Network (SGNN).
we have developed a new clustering method and a new clustering system, which can be easily scaled-up to very large data set.
we have developed a new method of distributed hierarchical Web document clustering, and built a clustering system based on this method.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the hierarchical clustering method is a powerful tool for Web mining, and it can be used for many different applications.
a distributed system can be built based on the hierarchical clustering method to automatically generate knowledge management systems for the web.
the method of clustering can be used to generate a conceptual hierarchy of the web documents.
